# Libraries and packages

Load our custom functions for running LOESS+DE-SWAN and investigating simulation results.

```{R}
source("../null_simulations/loess_utils.R")
```

Load libraries.

```{R}
library(DEswan)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)
```

# Figure 2

Generate the random data, with ages drawn from a normal distribution with mean 55 and standard deviation 7 and gene expression levels drawn from a standard normal distribution.

```{R}
set.seed(0303)
ages = rnorm(n=100, mean=55, sd=7)
gene = rnorm(100)
```

Define the DE-SWAN parameters.

```{R}
bucket = 20
windows = seq(min(ages)+bucket/2, max(ages)-bucket/2,by=1)
```

Define the grid of values for LOESS interpolation, run LOESS, and organize into a data frame for plotting.

```{R}
loess_grid = seq(min(ages),max(ages),by=0.5)
loess_mod = loess(gene ~ ages)
loess_original_data = predict(loess_mod)
loess_data = predict(loess_mod, 
                     newdata = loess_grid)
df = data.frame("age"=ages,
                "gene"=gene,
                "loess_data_original"=loess_original_data)
df_loess = data.frame("loess_grid" = loess_grid,
                      "loess_data"= loess_data)
```

Create Figure 2, panels a-d, from the simulated data and LOESS fit.

```{R}
p1 = df %>% ggplot(aes(x=ages,y=gene)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows)-bucket/2, 
                  xmax=min(windows)),
              alpha=0.4,fill="peachpuff2") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows), 
                  xmax=min(windows)+bucket/2), 
              alpha=0.4,
              fill="darkseagreen1") +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("age") + 
  ylab("expression") +
  theme_minimal()
p1
```

```{R}
p2 = df %>% ggplot(aes(x=ages,y=gene)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows)-bucket/2, 
                  xmax=min(windows)),
              alpha=0.4,fill="peachpuff2") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows), 
                xmax=min(windows)+bucket/2), 
            alpha=0.4,
            fill="darkseagreen1") +
  geom_point(alpha=0.1) +
  geom_line(aes(x=ages,y=loess_data_original),color="black") +
  xlab("age") + 
  ylab("expression") +
  theme_minimal()
p2
```

```{R}
p3 = df %>% ggplot(aes(x=ages,y=gene)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows)-bucket/2, 
                  xmax=min(windows)),
              alpha=0.4,fill="peachpuff2") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows), 
                  xmax=min(windows)+bucket/2), 
              alpha=0.4,
              fill="darkseagreen1") +
  geom_point(alpha=0.1) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=ages,y=loess_data_original),color="black")+
  xlab("age") + 
  ylab("expression") +
  theme_minimal()
p3
```

```{R}
p4 = df %>% ggplot(aes(x=ages,y=gene)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows)-bucket/2, 
                  xmax=min(windows)),
              alpha=0.4,fill="peachpuff2") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows), 
                  xmax=min(windows)+bucket/2), 
              alpha=0.4,
              fill="darkseagreen1") +
  geom_point(alpha=0.1) + 
  geom_point(data=df_loess, aes(x=loess_grid,
                                y=loess_data))+
  xlab("age") + 
  ylab("expression") +
  theme_minimal()
p4
```

Define "younger" and "older" windows for the first sliding window as an illustrative example.

```{R}
df$group = ifelse(df$age <= min(windows),"younger", 
                        ifelse(min(windows) < df$age &  
                                 df$age <= min(windows) + bucket/2, "older",NA))
df$group = fct_reorder(df$group, df$age)

df_loess$group = ifelse(df_loess$loess_grid <= min(windows),"younger", 
                        ifelse(min(windows) < df_loess$loess_grid &  
                df_loess$loess_grid <= min(windows) + bucket/2, "older",NA))
df_loess$group = fct_reorder(df_loess$group, df_loess$loess_grid)
```

Zoom in on the first window (ages 35-45).

```{R}
q1 = df %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=ages,y=gene)) +
  xlim(min(windows)-bucket/2,min(windows)+bucket/2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = min(windows),col="grey") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=-Inf, xmax=min(windows)),alpha=0.4,fill="peachpuff2") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows), xmax=Inf), alpha=0.4,fill="darkseagreen1") +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("age") + 
  ylab("expression") +
  theme_minimal()

q2 = ggplot(data = df, aes(x=ages,y=gene)) +
  xlim(min(windows)-bucket/2,min(windows)+bucket/2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = min(windows),col="grey") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=-Inf, xmax=min(windows)),alpha=0.4,fill="peachpuff2") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows), xmax=Inf), alpha=0.4,fill="darkseagreen1") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x=ages,y=loess_data_original),color="red") +
  xlab("age") + 
  ylab("expression") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Run DE-SWAN on the LOESS-interpolated data, using a bucket of size 20 and window centers incrementing by 1 year and designed to span the age range.

```{R}
bucket = 20
windows = seq(min(ages)+bucket/2, max(ages)-bucket/2,by=1)
de_swan_res = do_de_swan(age = loess_grid,
                response = t(data.frame(loess_data)),
                window = windows,
                buckets_size = bucket)
```

Plot first window expression without LOESS.

```{R}
q1 = ggplot(data = df, aes(x=ages,y=gene)) +
  xlim(min(windows)-bucket/2,min(windows)+bucket/2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = min(windows),col="grey") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=-Inf, xmax=min(windows)),alpha=0.4,fill="peachpuff2") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows), xmax=Inf), alpha=0.4,fill="darkseagreen1") +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("age") + 
  ylab("expression") +
  theme_minimal()
q1
```

Plot first window ranks without LOESS. 

```{R}
q8 = df %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(gene)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=group,y=rank,color=group)) + 
  geom_jitter(width=0.2,height=0)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("coral3","darkgreen")) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank()) 
q8
```

Plot first window boxplots and Wilcoxon test without LOESS.

```{R}
q7 = df %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y=gene,x=group,fill=group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA) + 
  geom_jitter(height=0,width=0.1) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("peachpuff2","darkseagreen1")) +
  stat_compare_means(position = position_nudge(y = -0.8,x=-0.3)) + 
  ylab("expression") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank()) 
q7
```


Plot first window LOESS-interpolated expression. 

```{R}
q3 = df %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=age,y=gene)) +
  xlim(min(windows)-bucket/2,min(windows)+bucket/2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = min(windows),col="grey") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=-Inf, xmax=min(windows)),alpha=0.4,fill="peachpuff2") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(xmin=min(windows), xmax=Inf), alpha=0.4,fill="darkseagreen1") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data=df_loess[!is.na(df_loess$group),],
             aes(x=loess_grid,y=loess_data),color="black") + 
  xlab("age") + 
  ylab("loess-interpolated expression") +
  theme_minimal()
q3
```

```{R}

  geom_jitter(width=0.2,height=0)+

```

Plot first window boxplots and Wilcoxon test results for LOESS-interpolated data.

```{R}
q5 = df_loess %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y=loess_data,x=group,fill=group)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(height=0,width=0.1) + 
  stat_compare_means(position = position_nudge(y = -0.1,x=0.6)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("peachpuff2","darkseagreen1")) +
  ylab("loess-interpolated expression") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.title.x= element_blank()) 
q5
```

Save plots.

```{R}
layout_matrix = matrix(c(1, 2, 3),nrow=1)
qplot1 = arrangeGrob(q1, q8, q7,
                    layout_matrix = layout_matrix)
qplot2 = arrangeGrob(q3, q6, q5,
                    layout_matrix = layout_matrix)
ggsave(qplot1,file="loess_de_swan_figure_b.jpeg",width=10,height=3.5,dpi=300)
ggsave(qplot2,file="loess_de_swan_figure_c.jpeg",width=10,height=3.5,dpi=300)
```
